verified_defects.where: web/practice/builder.js tip() (~line 35) and its callers: preset chips (~417), Settings panel and sheet options (~961-1110), #l1 (~1459)
verified_defects.what: Explanations moved into tooltips can't be reached on a touch phone. UI.tooltip only opens on mouse hover or keyboard focus (focus-visible), and a tap triggers neither. In a 390px touch context, tapping the dimmed 'Weakest 3' chip shows no reason, and tapping 'At the end, like a test' in the sheet shows no 'No feedback until you finish…'. The text appears nowhere on the page. The same holds for the Timing, Aim, Order, Spread, Fresh twins/Exactly, rough-levels and module-2 explanations. #l1 is a non-focusable span, so the skills/types/difficulty/format/'works on ≈ +N' summary is hover-only even on desktop keyboards. This breaks decision 7's 'one tap away … everything stays reachable'.
verified_defects.fix: Make tip() work on touch: when (hover: none) or the pointerType isn't a mouse, tapping the control, or a small (i) next to it, shows the text (a popover, UI.toast, or an inline help line under the tapped or selected option). An aria-disabled chip shows its reason on tap. Give #l1 tabindex=0 so its tooltip opens on focus.

fixer_report:
I fixed all three blockers and the four small followups that sit in my files. Two followups need other owners. `PYTHONPATH=. python3 server/test_flow.py` prints "all good", and `server/checks/s4.py` prints "ok S4 Practice server checks".

Branch v2/s4q was rebased onto master first, since master had moved on. I added two commits after the four earlier S4Q commits (2936def and ef2ba16), then ran `git switch --detach`. Nothing is left uncommitted, and the 8031 server is stopped.

**Blockers fixed**
- **Explanations on touch** (`web/practice/builder.js`, `tip()`): a touch or pen tap on a control now opens its tooltip once the tap's action has run. Many Settings controls redraw when tapped, so the code finds the new copy of the control under the finger and opens that one. A tap on a dimmed chip shows its reason. `#l1` now has `tabindex="0"` (`web/practice/index.html`), so its summary opens on keyboard focus. The Settings button keeps a hover-only tooltip, because tapping it opens the sheet, which already shows everything.
- **Facts repeated on the builder's first screen**:
  - The mistakes, marked and saved counts now appear only on the header links, not on the chips.
  - "Coach's pick" has no "· 2 mistakes" suffix. Its reasons, and the "most questions" reason for a new learner, are now its tooltip.
  - The "Why these" and "New here?" lines are gone from the page (`#coach` and `#newHere` removed), and so is "not practised yet". The diagnostic is still reachable as a quiet "Diagnostic" link for new learners.
  - I also dropped the Marked and Saved counts from their chips, because they repeated the header links the same way.
- **Fix action twice on the summary** (`session.js` `nextActions`): when the next-set pill is already the fix set, "Fix my N misses" moves into the More menu.

**Followups fixed**
- **Zeros**: the Settings forecast leaves out "0 due now", and leaves out the 14-day count when it equals the week count. The By difficulty legend drops "(0 measured)".
- **One-type groups**: a group holding a single type no longer prints a header above its row.
- **Unusable presets**: chips that can't run yet now sit behind a "More presets" toggle, with their reason one tap away.
- **Two `<main id="main">`**: the runner now mounts with `mainId: 'rnMain'`, and `#run main { view-transition-name: none; }` in `web/practice/session/index.html` stops the warning. The page's outer `<main>` stays, so the skip link still works during the run and on the summary. That means one `<main>` is still nested inside another. Removing it fully needs a runner change, and the outer one could only become a `<div>` if `UI.skip` handled a main that mounts after page load.

**Headless check** (`scratchpad/walk5.py`): these passed with no console errors at 1280 and 390, light and dark, for a new and a seeded learner:
- tapping "Weakest 3" shows its reason;
- tapping "At the end, like a test" shows its explanation;
- hovering "Coach's pick" and focusing `#l1` show their text;
- one `#main`, and no view-transition warning after leaving a session.

**Left for other owners**
- **`web/assets/runner.js`**:
  - "1 of 5 · 0 right" shows a zero, and "N of M" repeats the "Question 1 of 5" navigator.
  - At 390, "Mark" appears both in the tool strip and in the bottom bar.
  - It could drop its `<main>` so the page's `<main>` no longer holds a second one.
- **Shell (`web/assets/ui.js` / kit)**: the Today card shows "0 min today" and a "0 days" streak. At 390 the "Hold a tab for shortcuts" toast covers Start.
- **`spec/v2-state/briefs/S4-check.md` items 25, 27, 28 and 35**: their wording needs updating to decision 7.
- **Still on screen**: the summary's "Mistakes · 2 new" line still repeats the miss count (the defect's fix only asked about the button, so I left it).
